# PPIM Consulting (Priya Pratap Immigration Consulting)

> Immigration advisory practice based at 155 Smales Road, East Tāmaki, Auckland, New Zealand, with offices in Nadi and Suva, Fiji. Led by Priya Pratap, a licensed immigration adviser (Immigration Advisers Authority licence 201100160) and Registered Migration Agent in Australia (MARN 2217960). Advises on New Zealand and Australian visas. Phone +64 21 120 8592, email priya_pratap@ppimconsulting.co.nz.
